label: Copy
meaning: Copy the identified text to the clipboard.

label: Send
meaning: Submit the current follow-up or message.

label: Refresh
meaning: Read current tabs, accounts or models; never generate.

label: Reload
meaning: Reload saved settings, confirming discard of a dirty draft.

label: Hide sidebar
meaning: Hide navigation while retaining the current content and draft.

label: Show sidebar
meaning: Reveal navigation without changing the current content or draft.

label: Open main window
meaning: Open the full workspace from a compact surface.

label: Run
meaning: Execute the selected action with the current inputs.

label: Stop
meaning: Stop active work; retained output remains available.

label: Reuse
meaning: Restore a saved request as an editable draft without sending.

label: Regenerate
meaning: Start a new generation from the saved request; allowance or charges apply.

label: More
meaning: Reveal additional actions for the current item.

label: Details
meaning: Inspect saved inputs, output and recorded choices.

label: Close
meaning: Dismiss this surface without stopping active work.

label: Download
meaning: Save the generated image in its original format.
